column1: # slug|impact,uniqueness,significance,experience,depth|category overrides or -|individual rationale

semmering-railway|8.2,9.2,9.4,8.2,8.1|-|Pioneering mountain railway deserves high engineering significance, not palace-level immersion or discovery on an ordinary train journey; contrast Alishan Forest Railway and Hohensalzburg Fortress.

admont-abbey-library|8.6,9.0,8.8,8.6,7.4|-|Exceptional Baroque interior and monastic collection, but one library hall has much less visitor depth than a major art museum; compare National Palace Museum.
austrian-national-library-state-hall|8.7,9.0,8.9,8.6,7.6|-|Remarkable monumental library room; contained one-room visitor experience does not equal Forbidden City or Hofburg museum depth.
spanish-riding-school|8.5,9.1,9.0,8.5,8.2|-|Distinctive living equestrian tradition, but performance and training visit has less breadth than a large cultural museum or palace.
hallstatt-salt-mine|8.7,8.9,8.9,8.9,8.1|-|Historically meaningful mine-tour experience; avoid transferring the full Hallstatt landscape or town significance to the underground tour.
melk-abbey|9.0,9.2,9.3,9.2,8.7|-|Outstanding abbey architecture and tour, but the site lacks the globally singular breadth of the largest imperial ensembles.

hochosterwitz-castle|8.7,8.9,8.8,8.8,8.1|-|Memorable hilltop castle and multiple gates, yet regional fortification significance and visit depth are below internationally exceptional fortress complexes.
mozarts-birthplace|8.1,8.7,9.3,8.2,7.6|-|Mozart's international importance is not equivalent to the scale or interpretive depth of the small birthplace museum.
schloss-eggenberg|8.6,8.9,9.0,8.8,8.7|-|Important Graz palace with rooms and gardens, but not interchangeable with globally defining royal palace ensembles.
carnuntum-archaeological-park|8.7,8.9,9.0,8.8,8.4|-|Substantial Roman heritage interpretation, but archaeological scope does not rival Angkor or Ayutthaya city-scale ensembles.
eisriesenwelt-werfen|9.0,9.4,8.8,9.0,8.4|-|Superb ice-cave formation and guided visit, while significance and practical exploration are more limited than massive cave systems.
krimml-waterfalls|9.0,9.0,8.5,9.1,8.3|-|Powerful three-stage waterfall walk; the worldwide natural-science importance is below singular karst or waterfall systems.
grossglockner-summit|9.0,8.8,8.6,8.9,8.4|-|Major alpine summit with demanding outdoor experience; distinguish one peak from the entire Hohe Tauern National Park.
vienna-state-opera|9.0,9.2,9.3,9.1,8.7|-|Exceptional performance venue and architectural heritage; distinguish interior tour from full global significance of opera as a performing art.
st-stephens-cathedral|9.1,9.2,9.3,9.1,8.8|-|Vienna's landmark Gothic cathedral, but visitor breadth does not match top multi-building heritage ensembles.
belvedere-palace|9.0,9.1,9.2,9.2,9.0|-|Palace and Klimt collection justify very high culture; avoid valuing it like the entire wider imperial palace network.
mauthausen-memorial|9.1,9.4,9.8,9.0,8.8|-|Profound Holocaust and forced-labor history warrants exceptional significance; separate emotional impact and scope from an entire multi-site museum network.
natural-history-museum-vienna|8.7,8.8,8.8,9.1,9.1|-|Excellent natural-history collection and architecture, but globally outstanding category does not require nearly perfect core significance.

grossglockner-high-alpine-road|9.2,9.1,8.9,9.5,8.9|-|48-km alpine panorama road offers several exhibitions and many stops; distinctive road but less ecological and exploratory scope than the entire Hohe Tauern protected area. Retain outstanding experience, slightly constrain global historical significance. Source: https://www.grossglockner.at/en/article/zeitplanung-ausflug_a829

hofburg-palace|9.3,9.3,9.6,9.3,9.6|-|Retain top-tier integrated imperial palace and museums: Imperial Apartments and Sisi Museum offer meaningful site-specific depth beyond a ceremonial building. Source: https://www.sisimuseum-hofburg.at/en/about-the-location/imperial-apartments

hohe-tauern-national-park|9.4,9.1,9.0,9.5,9.4|-|Retain exceptional alpine landscape depth: 1856 square kilometres of glaciated peaks and diverse natural habitats, not merely one panoramic road or summit. Source: https://www.nationalpark.at/en/nationalpark

hohensalzburg-fortress|9.1,9.1,9.3,9.4,8.9|-|Retain rare intact medieval hill fortress, architectural/urban panorama and substantive museums, as a complete structure rather than borrowing Salzburg citywide fame. UNESCO setting and historical value compared with other castles. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/at

kunsthistorisches-museum|9.2,9.4,9.6,9.4,9.5|-|Retain high-ranked encyclopedic imperial museum and strong permanent Old Master holdings; globally competitive museum collection with meaningful sustained visitor depth. Compared against National Palace Museum and National Museum of Korea. Source: https://www.khm.at/en/

schoenbrunn-palace|9.4,9.3,9.6,9.5,9.3|-|Retain verified world-renowned Habsburg palace and garden ensemble: heritage, architecture and large grounds genuinely support global palace-scale visitor depth. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/statesparties/at

wachau-valley|8.9,8.8,9.2,9.4,9.6|-|Retain broad valley-scale exploration; Danube riverscape, vineyard terraces, monasteries and settlements form a coherent UNESCO cultural landscape rather than one point or viewpoint. Source: https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/970

gesaeuse-national-park|8.9,8.8,8.7,9.1,9.2|nature=9.4|Gesäuse National Park contains dramatic Enns river gorges, limestone walls, endemic species and extensive mountain hiking; global significance is meaningful but does not equal the planet's most vast national parks. Source: https://www.nationalparksaustria.at/en/national-park-gesaeuse.html

wildspitze|8.7,8.4,7.7,8.5,7.8|-|Wildspitze is Austria's second-highest peak and demands a serious mountaineering glacier ascent; its individual summit visit has comparatively limited global historic singularity versus entire alpine ranges. Source: https://www.pitztaler-gletscher.at/en/pitztal-glacier-and-rifflsee/summer/mountaineering-and-hiking/die-wildspitze.html

bregenz-floating-stage|8.7,9.1,8.8,8.7,7.5|culture=9.3|Bregenz Seebühne is documented as the world's largest lake stage and an internationally prominent summer opera production venue, yet its memorable full experience is performance-dependent rather than a standalone day-long museum. Source: https://www.festspielhausbregenz.com/en/event-planning/venue-rental/seebuehne/

nordkette-hafelekar|8.6,8.3,7.2,8.8,8.2|-|Hafelekar provides striking Karwendel panoramas directly above Innsbruck via connected cableways and hiking trails; impressive access and city view do not create world-defining scientific or historical uniqueness. Source: https://nordkette.com/en/top-of-innsbruck/

hohenwerfen-castle|8.7,8.6,8.7,9.0,8.5|architecture=9.0,history=8.8|Hohenwerfen is a richly visitable medieval cliff-top fortress with interior tours, falconry shows and several exhibitions; its tourist experience is stronger than a mere external photo stop, though less globally singular than great imperial fortresses. Source: https://www.burg-hohenwerfen.at/en/your-visit

kalkalpen-national-park|8.7,9.0,9.1,8.6,9.0|nature=9.4,wildlife=9.2|Kalkalpen National Park contains internationally important old-growth beech forests within a UNESCO serial natural property; strong ecological and forest depth merit better scores, but typical visitor experience is narrower than alpine panorama parks. Source: https://www.nationalparksaustria.at/en/national-park-kalkalpen.html

neusiedler-see-seewinkel-national-park|8.5,8.8,9.2,8.7,8.8|nature=9.1,wildlife=9.4|Neusiedler See–Seewinkel protects internationally significant Central European steppe wetlands and migratory bird habitat within Ramsar and a wider UNESCO cultural landscape; scientific merit is high without assuming universally spectacular scenery. Source: https://www.bmluk.gv.at/themen/wasser/wasser-eu-international/europaeische-und-internationale-wasserwirtschaft/feuchtgebiete/ramsar/neusiedlersee.html

gosausee|8.4,8.0,6.8,8.8,7.1|nature=9.0,photography=9.2|Vorderer Gosausee has exceptional reflected Dachstein mountain scenery and a comfortable lake circuit, but as a single small alpine lake its global geomorphological significance and independent exploration depth are modest. Source: https://dachstein.salzkammergut.at/en/visitor-information/our-lakes/lake-gosau.html

achensee|8.4,8.0,7.1,8.8,8.4|-|Achensee is Tirol's largest lake with boat routes, lakeside towns and accessible mountain sports, providing meaningful recreation but not globally unrepeatable geological or historical heritage. Source: https://www.achensee.com/en/travel-information/facts-figures/

dachstein-skywalk|8.4,8.1,6.5,8.6,6.5|photography=9.1|The Dachstein Sky Walk is a dramatic glass viewing platform above a cliff, but the attraction itself is a short photo stop and must not inherit the entire glacier area's geological and trekking depth. Source: https://www.derdachstein.at/en/dachstein-glacier-world/attractions/sky-walk?vicarage=0

zillertal-alps|8.9,8.9,8.1,9.1,9.6|nature=9.2,adventure=9.3|Zillertal Alps nature park spans extensive high mountain wilderness and trails, justifying major hiking depth and memorable alpine scenery, without treating all individual summits as equally irreplaceable worldwide. Source: https://www.naturpark-zillertal.at/der-naturpark.html

schafberg|8.5,8.1,7.1,8.8,7.5|photography=9.2|Schafberg offers spectacular Salzkammergut lake panoramas reached by historic cog railway or mountain hike, but the mountain viewpoint should not inherit the railway's separate historic engineering significance or the whole lake region's depth. Source: https://www.5schaetze.at/en/schafbergbahn.html

hallstaetter-see|8.4,8.2,7.2,8.6,8.1|nature=9.0|Lake Hallstatt is a scenic boating and walking destination framing the UNESCO Hallstatt cultural landscape, but its standalone lake significance must remain separate from the famous salt-mining town's full history. Source: https://dachstein.salzkammergut.at/en/visitor-information/our-lakes/lake-hallstatt.html

dachstein-krippenstein-five-fingers|8.4,8.2,6.4,8.6,6.3|photography=9.2|Five Fingers provides a dramatic elevated Hallstatt panorama from one viewing platform, but a short lookout should not inherit either the Dachstein massif or the surrounding UNESCO Salzkammergut region's independent visitor depth. Source: https://www.dachstein-salzkammergut.com/en/sommer/oberirdisch/5fingers
